The catalog has a walking-isochrone process, but it is not in this graph, so the 300-metre zones are an approximation of walking reach. Second, the catalog has no process for producing a styled map. The rings and coverage area are the geometry from which a map showing the well-served parts and the distance increments would be drawn, but that rendering step is outside this graph.
